steps.S01: Survey, level the supports, convert the old door to W1, seal end B
steps.S02: Seal the floor, prime the steel, foam-fill the corrugation valleys
steps.S03: Fix battens and fit EPS between them; foam-seal every joint
steps.S04: Fix the numbered lining panels (cut-outs already in place)
steps.S05: Services first fix: earth rod, conduits and cables, pipes in the floor void; pressure-test the pipes before any lining closes
steps.S06: Stand the partition frame and fix the living-face skins
steps.S07: Fit the door frame and hang the bathroom door
steps.S08: Cement board, membrane and tiles on the wet walls; coved vinyl floor
steps.S09: Set the shower tray, ledge and fixed screen
steps.S10: Hang the WC, basin and mirror cabinet
steps.S11: Assemble the fridge bay, hob base and sink base on their legs
steps.S12: Assemble the tall unit, fix it to blocking, hang the heater bracket inside
steps.S13: Scribe and fix the worktop; drop in the sink and hob; plinth
steps.S14: Hang the wall units and the hood shelf on the steel rail
steps.S15: Bolt the bed frame, drop in the deck panels, slide in the drawers
steps.S16: Assemble the wardrobe, fix to blocking, hang the door
steps.S17: Slot together the table and stools
steps.S18: Scribe and pin the trims; caulk and paint
steps.S19: Second fix: unit board, devices, lights, alarms; test and certify
steps.S20: Lift and bolt the deck beams onto the corner castings; joists
steps.S21: Screw down the deck boards (5 mm gaps)
steps.S23: Stand the canopy posts; rafters; polycarbonate; gutter
steps.S24: Veranda posts, ledger and polycarbonate over the front deck
steps.S25: Set the stair footings; bolt the two flights and the landing
steps.S26: Place the chairs and the side table
steps.S27: Bond the steelwork to earth; engineer's inspection before guest use
